decisions.reason: The digital anamnesis and consent app is close to the core software, costs little to maintain, and gains value as practices digitalize, so the option is still worth holding.
The education institute builds on the firm's training resources and customer relationships, and its carrying cost is moderate, though its value as an option remains somewhat uncertain.
Remote screen-sharing support is cheap to run, underpins the core support offering, and became more valuable after the shift to remote work.
The analytics dashboard extends the core data and fits the strategy of efficiently managed practices; its upside is still uncertain and keeping it adds little cost.
The complete practice bundle is essentially a packaging of existing modules, so it costs little to keep and helps win new practices.

The listing portal is distant from the core, faces strong outside competitors, and had only a minor web presence, so it is the weakest option, but its low running cost still favors keeping it for now.
